parameter_name: ### Uniform initial density; remodelled by cells via degrade/deposit rules.
### Phase-cycle dwell times (in simulation time steps at dt=0.1 h)
### G1~8h -> 80 steps; S~7h -> 70 steps; G2~4h -> 40 steps
### O2 chemotaxis: stochastic_local for biologically realistic biased motility
### Explicit mode: stochastic_local gives biased but not deterministic migration.
### Compare with local_best or gradient to validate chemotactic sensitivity.
### Inverse temperature β for Boltzmann selection (higher = more deterministic)
### Tie-breaking epsilon suppresses movement on numerical noise (local_best only)
### ECM haptotaxis: cells preferentially move along ECM density gradients
### ECM haptotaxis uses local_best: deterministic sensing of structural gradient
### integrin_sensitivity: weight of ECM adhesion signal per unit ECM density
### anoikis_threshold: ECM adhesion signal below which anoikis is triggered
### anoikis_probability: per-step probability of anoikis once threshold crossed
### k_degrade: ECM degradation rate per step (MMP-mediated proteolysis)
### k_deposit: ECM deposition rate per step (fibronectin/collagen secretion)
### ecm_saturation: maximum ECM density (logistic cap on deposition)
### Necrosis Pathway (hypoxia + prolonged arrest -> necrotic transformation)
